title: Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor Rep. Nick Begich's bill to write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law, with a 20-year ban on selling its bitcoin, is now eligible for a House floor vote. This post Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
